dimensions.summary: Package boundaries and documentation align, but WIS RFC-0001/RFC-0002 and SH1 semantic-lock decisions are not accepted and therefore cannot support a stable contract claim.
Deterministic multi-contract generation, extension bounds, workload classes and registered domain adoption remain executable without adding domain rules to Shared.
Local latency, bundle, tarball, soak and retained-heap budgets pass; real-browser timing and platform peak-memory profiling remain required.
Hostile resource, generator, path, file, UTF-8, cancellation, prototype, package-content and accidental-publication boundaries pass locally with zero runtime dependencies.
Library surfaces perform no I/O or telemetry, CLI results omit payloads and paths, and private internal consumption does not expose raw source, payloads or credentials.
Linux installed-library and CLI evidence passes and CI now retains run-bound OS attestations, but same-candidate macOS, Windows and real-browser artifacts have not run and been reviewed.
Shared remains a dependency leaf, Graph consumes public subpaths through an acyclic exact-version edge, and the central CLI has no developing-package dependency or import.
Thirteen Shared test files with 113 tests pass alongside deterministic generation, schema digests, strict semantic fixtures and installed artifact execution.
Current/previous negotiation and explicit migration losses pass, but a stable compatibility promise cannot precede acceptance of the normative SH1 semantics.
Cancellation, bounded diagnostics, invalid input, unsupported versions and CLI exit semantics are deterministic; the admission audit distinguishes invalid, failed and blocked outcomes.
Machine registries, permanent quality policy, stage closures, canonical documentation, drift tests and an executable admission decision keep package claims reviewable and extensible.
The private installed tarball produces a validated CycloneDX 1.5 component, has zero runtime dependencies and remains protected from npm publication.

checks.evidence: Shared and Graph quality, dependency, mirror, generation, coverage, build, scale, packed-consumer, SBOM and admission-audit gates passed locally
The strict decision correctly reported blocked with exit 2 and did not authorize admission
CI capture is configured; same-commit macOS and Windows artifacts have not yet been produced and reviewed
Graph consumes the exact Shared workspace version through public subpaths and isolated packed tarballs
2 gates passed, 4 passed locally, 4 await remote evidence and 3 are blocked; admission remains false

remainingRisks: WIS RFC-0001/RFC-0002 and SH1 semantic-lock decisions remain unaccepted.
Same-candidate macOS, Windows and real-browser run-bound evidence is absent.
True platform peak-memory evidence is absent.
Internal compatibility and migration commitments remain blocked by the normative semantic lock.
Commit-bound internal promotion and rollback evidence are absent.
npm publication remains prohibited; standalone stability claims, SH8 and the central CLI bridge remain unauthorized.

approval.rule: This blocked package-stability closure cannot be approved or authorize SH8 until every required SH7 gate is passed with reviewed evidence.
